questions.question: What was the special role of the tribe of Levi?
options: To serve Aaron and care for the tabernacle
To farm the land and provide grain
To lead Israel's armies into battle
To rule over and judge the other eleven tribes
questions.answer: To serve Aaron and care for the tabernacle

questions.question: Whom did the Levites substitute for, belonging to the LORD?
Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu had died before the LORD.
The Levites were given to _____ and his sons to do the service of the tabernacle.
The Levites were taken by the LORD instead of all the _____ of Israel.
